source_text: 78. Dans Jérémie on trouve la prédiction de la mort de Jésus et de sa descente aux enfers: «Et le Seigneur, le Saint d'Israël, s'est souvenu de ses morts, de ceux qui dormaient déjà dans le sein de la terre, et il est descendu vers eux pour leur annoncer son salut et pour les délivrer.» La cause de sa mort est indiquée: sa descente aux enfers était le salut des trépassés
pass_a_gloss: §78 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Descent to Hades to save the sleeping dead.
pass_b_english: In Jeremiah one finds the prediction of Jesus’ death and of his descent to the dead: ‘And the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, remembered his dead, those who were already sleeping in the bosom of the earth, and he went down to them to announce his salvation and to deliver them.’ ([[1 Pet 3:18-19 >> Bible:1 Pet 3:18-19]]; [[1 Pet 4:6 >> Bible:1 Pet 4:6]]; [[Eph 4:9 >> Bible:Eph 4:9]])
The cause of his death is indicated: his descent to the dead was the salvation of those who had passed away.
